label: Cheese powder
step: melt with water and salts, spray-dry

about.text: Cheese melted with water and emulsifying salts into a smooth liquid and spray-dried to a powder. It goes into sauces, biscuits, dressings, snack seasonings and the packet in boxed macaroni and cheese; one cheese or several can be used, and the mix sets how much fat and protein it has.

links.name: Felix da Silva et al., Powder Technology 378 (2021)

how.text: Cheese is minced, melted with water and emulsifying salts (usually phosphates) into a uniform "cheese feed", heated, often homogenised, and sprayed into hot air. Without the salts the hot cheese parts into fat and water, and the powder comes out coarse, dark and lumpy.

steps.name: melt
steps.note: With water and emulsifying salts, usually phosphates (about 3.5 %), into a uniform cheese feed of about 38 % dry matter.
Sprayed into hot air, 190 °C in and 60 °C out.
